mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) combined with lamotrigine may increase serotonergic activity and lower seizure threshold, with potential for serotonin syndrome and reduced anticonvulsant efficacy.
action: Avoid combination or use only with extreme caution under close monitoring; if necessary, initiate lamotrigine at lowest dose with gradual titration and monitor for serotonergic symptoms and seizure control.
